BOOSTING CAMPUS LIFE:
NEW INITIATIVES FOR STUDENT ENGAGEMENT
Elmbrook College has launched several initiatives to enhance student
engagement this fall. The Campus Connections program now offers
over 100 clubs and organizations, ranging from environmental activism
to tech innovation. Students can explore diverse interests and build
communities around shared passions.
The revamped student-housing system features themed residence halls,
including Sustainability House and Global Cultures House, designed to
foster deeper connections among residents with similar values.
These learning communities encourage collaboration beyond the
classroom. The Career Center has partnered with local businesses to
create 300 part-time job opportunities for students. Additionally, the
Volunteer Hub platform matches students with community-service
projects aligned with their interests and academic goals.
“These programs will significantly enrich campus life and support our
students’ personal and professional growth,” said College President
Dr. Emily Caldwell. The initiatives aim to prepare students for success
during and after graduation.
